note: Non-profit regional park 3 km south of Estevan on Hwy 47, in an oxbow of the Souris River among maple trees beside the 18-hole Woodlawn golf course; rebuilt after the 2011 flood. Mostly seasonal: about 30 of its roughly 180 RV sites, plus 20 tent sites, are sold by the night online. No grad parties on the May long weekend. --Claude
summary: Keep. Woodlawn Main (regional park): all full-service 30 A sites; C$50 a night RV, C$25 tent, C$10/day park entry; books on Let's Camp. Nightly share ~25% (30 RV + 20 tent online of ~200 sites on the park map) - mostly seasonal, said in the note. Riverview kept: nightly sites 53, 54, 57, 58, 60 along the Souris (~20-27 m wide here) behind a tree belt. Google 4.2 (112). Lead: Woodlawn Boundary Dam campground (same operator, ~8 km S) is not in the DB.
flags: NIGHTLY SHARE: Let's Camp sells 50 sites online - 30 full-service RV sites (53, 54, 57, 58, 60-63, 66, 67, 70, 81, 87, 89-105) and tent sites T1-T20 - out of ~198 site shapes on the 2026 park map (main loops 1-105, G sites 1-22, Circle 1-8, SVT 1-17, 16-31 across the river, R sites 1-15, tenting, plus overflow A/B/C 1-10). About 25% nightly: kept at 10-50%, so the note says 'Mostly seasonal'. The site's own wording: 'Daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal rates. Seasonal sites run May 1 – Sept. 30. Email manager@woodlawnregionalpark.com to join the wait list.' Not iffy: posted nightly rate, live booking site, 112 Google reviews.

WATERFRONT: 'riverview' kept (not upgraded). Let's Camp describes nightly sites 57 ('This site is blocked off at the rear by trees. It is a riverside site.'), 60 ('backs up to the riverside'), 54 ('with a river view') and 58 ('near the river'); they are the Woodlawn Drive row on the west side of the oxbow (~49.1154,-102.9793). Esri shows the Souris only ~20-27 m wide here (under 30 m = creekside size, never riverfront) and a continuous tree/brush belt between the row and the water; the site photos of 54, 57 and 60 show no water through the trees. Within ~30-40 m but not over open ground, so no on-water value; riverview is the most it holds.
